pages.text: A crystal ball set in pale steel instead of gold. It has no bond with the Crone and will never call her, but it scries just as well: a filled $(l:crafts/waystone)Waystone$() shows the place from above and a filled $(l:crafts/taglock_kit)Taglock Kit$() lets you look through the victim's eyes.
Both target and location must be in the same dimension, loaded, and within about a thousand blocks of the ball; the victim must also be either a player or near one.
